events.title: Interview with Omniscient conducted by Connected.
events.description: Interview with Omniscient conducted by Connected; covers his revival of HackerCraft through hands-on administration, the 2 million UID milestone, his thoughts on declining post counts being driven by anti-spam policies, his ambivalence over groups, and his work-from-home schedule of up to 16 hour days.

events.title: Interview with D3xus conducted by Saturday.
events.description: Interview with D3xus conducted by Saturday; covers his memberships in The Alliance, Infamous, Wiki Team, and MRT, his recent promotion to full Staff, his iOS/Android usage, and his goal of attending Cornell University.

events.title: Interview with webdev77 conducted by Educate.
events.description: Interview with webdev77 conducted by Educate; covers his free-hosting support staff role, his engineering major, his bruteforce/word-scramble project that led him to HF in 2011, and his Alliance membership focused on the Computer Hardware sector.
